Package io.github.roebi.qffxguilib.telemetry

Class ServerSpans

java.lang.Object
io.github.roebi.qffxguilib.telemetry.ServerSpans
public final class ServerSpans extends Object
Factory for server-side OTel spans.

All methods require ServerTelemetry.init() to have been called first. Use with try-with-resources: 

   try (ActiveSpan s = ServerSpans.resolverLookup(clientId, componentId, stepId)) {
       return resolverRegistry.resolve(componentId);
   }

Measurement points covered

  1. resolverLookup(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) - time to find the resolver for a component
  2. agentRoundTrip(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) - time from command send to client ACK
